findings.title: bank_tracker.cmd_pre_bank declares source cmd_gen.fb_pre_bank, but the design needs glue
findings.detail: The manifest says bank_tracker.cmd_pre_bank is driven directly by cmd_gen.fb_pre_bank. It is not: cmd_gen's feedback interface carries a bank number only for ACTIVATE (fb_act_bank); its PRE/RD/WR pulses are bankless, yet bank_tracker needs cmd_pre_bank/cmd_rd_bank/cmd_wr_bank to track per-bank state. The harness registers the scheduler's cmd_bank one cycle so it aligns with the REGISTERED fb pulses. This is testbench glue standing in for a missing design signal — see the filed finding; the Frontend should add fb_pre_bank/fb_rd_bank/fb_wr_bank. Driver used: scheduler.cmd_bank. Either the RTL should consume cmd_gen.fb_pre_bank as declared, or the manifest should stop claiming a direct connection.

findings.title: data_path.cmd_aux declares source cmd_gen.cmd_out_aux, but the design needs glue
findings.detail: The manifest says data_path.cmd_aux is driven directly by cmd_gen.cmd_out_aux. It is not: cmd_gen's feedback carries no aux tag, but data_path needs the issued command's aux to tag read responses (rd_rsp_aux). Registered one cycle to align with the registered fb_rd_valid/fb_wr_valid pulses. Same missing-feedback-signal gap as the bank workaround — covered by the filed fb-bank finding; the design wants fb_aux. Driver used: scheduler.cmd_aux. Either the RTL should consume cmd_gen.cmd_out_aux as declared, or the manifest should stop claiming a direct connection.

findings.title: data_path.wr_data_valid declares source wb_port.req_valid, but the design needs expr_glue
findings.detail: The manifest says data_path.wr_data_valid is driven directly by wb_port.req_valid. It is not: data_path buffers a write word when wb_port's write request is ACCEPTED (valid && we && ready). No single design port carries that event; it is the same accept condition cmd_queue enqueues on. Driver used: wb_port.req_valid && wb_port.req_we && cmd_queue.enq_ready. Either the RTL should consume wb_port.req_valid as declared, or the manifest should stop claiming a direct connection.
